exit_meanings.2: malformed CLI or deterministic contract failure
exit_meanings.3: blocked/wait/unknown external outcome or unavailable native telemetry/isolation
exit_meanings.4: CAS, lock, or concurrent protected-root snapshot conflict

signal_exception: SIGKILL, OOM, and interpreter-startup failure may emit no JSON and use platform startup or 128+signal exit

authoritative_behavior_audit_exceptions.reason: successful native runtime execution is same-run authoritative evidence and cannot be recursively audited by pytest
launcher success creates and invokes the authoritative verifier and cannot recurse inside pytest
orchestrator success executes the complete pytest and native gates and cannot recurse inside itself
